tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task/issue in Linear. Use when the user wants to remember a to-do or action item. Optionally assign it to a project, or make it a subtask of another issue by passing that issue's id as 'parent' (get ids from list_tasks / list_projects).

project.description: Optional Linear project id to file it under (from list_projects).

parent.description: Optional parent issue id to make this a subtask (from list_tasks).

tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: Plan a goal by creating a parent task plus its subtasks in Linear in one step. Use when the user wants to 'planificar', break a goal into steps, or create a task that has several subtasks at once. Provide the parent 'title' and a 'subtasks' array of titles. To file the plan under a project: pass an existing project id as 'project', OR pass 'new_project' with a name to create a new project for it.

title.description: The plan/goal = the parent task title.

project.description: Optional EXISTING Linear project id (from list_projects).

new_project.description: Optional NAME of a new project to create and file the whole plan under.

subtasks.description: Subtask titles; each becomes a child issue under the parent.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project in Linear. Use when the user wants a new project to organize tasks under. Returns the project id, name and url.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the user's Linear tasks/issues grouped by project, with subtasks nested under their parent. Use for 'what's on my plate', 'what's pending', 'show my tasks'. Returns { projects: [ { name, tasks: [ { id, ref, title, state, priority, url, children:[...] } ] } ] }.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the user's active Linear projects (id, name, progress). Use to group tasks, to answer 'what projects do I have', or to get a project id before creating a task under it.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update an existing Linear task/issue: title, description, priority, or due date. Requires the task id (get it from list_tasks).

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Change a Linear task's status/state (e.g. mark it done, or move To do → In progress). Requires the task id.

state.description: Target state name, e.g. 'Done', 'In Progress', 'Todo'. Defaults to 'Done'.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a Google Calendar event. Provide ISO 8601 start/end with the -04:00 (America/Puerto_Rico) offset.

end.description: ISO 8601 end. If omitted, defaults to 1h after start.

tools.name: list_today_events
tools.description: List the user's upcoming Google Calendar events (from now through the next 7 days), sorted, with date and time.

tools.name: save_note
tools.description: Save a note to the second brain (git-backed vault). Use @folder to route and #tags to label.

tools.name: search_brain
tools.description: Browse the second brain: return the folder/note tree, optionally within a subfolder.

tools.name: search_brain_semantic
tools.description: Search the user's second brain by meaning (semantic/RAG) to answer questions grounded in their own notes, e.g. 'what did I decide about the Ocra ingress?'. Returns the most relevant note excerpts with links. Prefer this over search_brain when answering a question from the notes.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web for current, real-world information the model cannot know from memory: weather, news, prices, sports scores, recent events, product/library docs, 'what is the latest ...'. Returns titles, URLs and snippets (and an instant answer when available). Use this whenever the answer depends on up-to-date facts. Do NOT use it for the user's own notes (use search_brain_semantic) or personal data.

query.description: The search query, in natural language.

categories.description: Optional SearXNG category, e.g. 'news' for recent news, 'general' (default).

time_range.description: Optional recency filter: day, week, month, or year.

tools.name: query_metrics
tools.description: Query the homelab's Prometheus with a PromQL expression to read live metrics (CPU, RAM, disk, GPU utilization/memory, service up/down). Use when the user asks about the state or health of the homelab or a node, or when a decision depends on current resource usage (e.g. 'is the GPU free?', 'how full is Ocra's disk?', 'which node is under load?'). Returns matching series with labels and values.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and folders in the user's Nextcloud, at an optional path. Use for 'what's in my Documents folder', 'list my files'. Returns items with name, path, isDir, size, mtime.

path.description: Folder path, e.g. 'Documents' or 'Documents/2026'. Empty = root.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in Nextcloud at the given path.

path.description: Full folder path to create, e.g. 'Documents/Proyectos'.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file/folder in Nextcloud (src → dst full paths).

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file/folder in Nextcloud (moves it to the Nextcloud trash).

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Create a public share link for a file/folder in Nextcloud. Optionally password-protect it.

tools.name: storage_usage
tools.description: Report Nextcloud storage usage (used / total).
